sources.quote: 8.3.3.3 Any change to a characteristic designated special, to its control method or to its sampling frequency needs written approval from Stellantis before the change is implemented.
Certificate review plus tensile test, 1 specimen per heat
SPECIAL CHARACTERISTIC SC-01, controlled per control plan CP-BR220-R3.
BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL

findings.why: Reducing the tensile test on BR-220 from 1 specimen per heat to 1 per 3 heats changes the sampling frequency of the control for SC-01 (Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa). BR-220 is in program STL-Torino-27, which is in Annex A of the STL requirements. CSR clause 8.3.3.3 requires written Stellantis approval before the change is implemented. No document in force gives that approval. The claim that there has never been a tensile failure does not replace it.
